payload.summary: Source register cannot represent an undated live register or a review-dated page
payload.detail: Seven dictionary-handover sources were read from their publishers on 2026-09-16 and genuinely publish no date: the WA Chief Psychiatrist forms, AMHP and PMP pages, WA data collections, the WHO mhGAP safety-planning page, and WA Health consent (which carries only 'Last reviewed: 22-05-2026'). acquisitionLedgerIssues requires a publicationDate for every non-rejected record, so none can be admitted even though all are governed WA or WHO sources. Options: let the ledger hold a null publicationDate for a continuously updated register, or cite the dated underlying documents instead of the landing pages. Findings and next actions are per source in src/data/dictionary-source-dispositions.json under publisherCheck.
